query:
UPDATE message_templates
               SET name = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), name),
                   template_type = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), template_type),
                   title_template = COALESCE(NULLIF($4, ''), title_template),
                   content_template = COALESCE(NULLIF($5, ''), content_template),
                   is_active = $6,
                   updated_at = NOW()
               WHERE id = $1
               RETURNING id
